name: Tauernappartments Kircherhof
beschreibung: The Tauernappartements Kircherhof in Matrei in Osttirol are a family-run apartment house of the Bernd Brugger family in a quiet location on a small hill, just a few minutes' walk from the town centre. Nine spacious apartments furnished in traditional alpine style – including Tauernfensterl, Guggenberg, Kircher, Panorama and Anna – feature a south-west facing balcony with panoramic views of Matrei and the Hohe Tauern. The fully equipped kitchen-living rooms offer an electric stove, dishwasher, coffee machine and kettle, plus satellite TV, radio and WiFi throughout the house. A common room is available for sociable hours. The ski bus stop is right at the house, and the Großglockner Resort Kals-Matrei can be reached in a few minutes. Parking spaces are available free of charge.
